therapy_decision.reasoning_steps: A 70-year-old never smoker with stage IV adenocarcinoma, PD-L1 85%, no driver mutations and pleural/bone metastases. High PD-L1 without contraindication supports first-line pembrolizumab monotherapy, which is guideline-preferred and avoids chemotherapy-related toxicity.

best_therapy_reimbursed.reason: Pembrolizumab monotherapy reimbursed for PD-L1 >= 50% metastatic NSCLC.

therapy_decision.raw_decision: Recommended first-line therapy: Pembrolizumab monotherapy (immunotherapy alone).

raw_messages.content: First-line treatment for patients with advanced NSCLC with PS 0-1, tumour PD-L1 >= 50% and without contraindication for ICI: Pembrolizumab is considered a standard first-line option [I, A; ESMO-MCBS v1.1 score: 5]. Monotherapy ICI is not recommended for tumours with PD-L1 < 50% [I, D].
